title: Know-Thy-Not: Training-Free Targeted Negation in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dual-encoder vision-language models systematically fail at negation, scoring ''a cat without a dog'' nearly identically to ''a cat with a dog.'' We show that this failure is inherent to the single-embedding framework. Under contrastive training, single-embedding methods can at best ignore the negated concept (dilution) but never penalize its presence (rejection). We propose Know-Thy-Not (KTN), a training-free method that introduces an image-side rejection dimension to penalize the negated concept directly in the visual representation. We also introduce COCO-Confusion, the first benchmark requiring genuine rejection to succeed. Across 9 backbones, KTN improves COCO-Confusion mAP by up to +25.6 over vanilla VLMs and +9.6 over the strongest existing method.

translated_title: 知其否：双编码器视觉-语言模型中的免训练定向否定处理
translated_abstract: 双编码器视觉-语言模型在否定处理上存在系统性失败，对“一只没有狗的猫”和“一只带有狗的猫”的评分几乎相同。我们证明这种失败是单嵌入框架固有的：在对比训练下，单嵌入方法充其量只能忽略被否定的概念（稀释），但永远无法对其存在进行惩罚（拒绝）。我们提出Know-Thy-Not（KTN），一种免训练方法，通过引入图像侧的拒绝维度，直接在视觉表示中对被否定的概念进行惩罚。我们还引入了COCO-Confusion，这是首个需要真正的拒绝能力才能成功的基准测试。在9个骨干网络上，KTN使COCO-Confusion的mAP相比原始视觉-语言模型提升高达+25.6，相比最强现有方法提升+9.6。
tldr: KTN是一种免训练方法，通过在视觉表示中引入图像侧拒绝维度来直接惩罚被否定的概念，从根本上解决了双编码器视觉-语言模型无法真正“拒绝”否定概念这一固有缺陷，在COCO-Confusion基准上mAP相比原始模型提升高达+25.6。
en_tdlr: KTN is a training-free method that introduces an image-side rejection dimension to directly penalize negated concepts in visual representations, addressing the inherent inability of dual-encoder vision-language models to truly reject negated concepts, with up to +25.6 mAP improvement on the COCO-Confusion benchmark.
